environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has two listener rules evaluated in priority order: Priority 1 is a custom rule matching path pattern '/api/users/search' with a query-string condition (key 'q', value pattern containing any of: quote characters, semicolons, UNION keyword, comment sequences) that returns a fixed 403 response. Priority 2 forwards to the target group. Additionally, the ECS task role has an IAM policy with a condition restricting the task's outbound network via VPC endpoint policies that deny all internet-bound traffic (egress only to S3 gateway and CloudWatch Logs endpoints), preventing data exfiltration even if blind SQLi succeeds. The container runs with a read-only root filesystem with /var/lib/app mounted as a tmpfs, and the SQLite WAL mode is disabled.

ecs_task_networking.vpc_endpoint_policy: deny all egress except s3 gateway and logs endpoint
ecs_task_networking.internet_gateway_route: not present in task subnet route table
